edits.new: The ground lands: what the meter proves and what the eye sees (corrected 2026-11-13 after wiring review 4, fault H2). Each ribbon has two ground lands that its own copper joins: A6 and A8 on FLEX1 (an F.Cu strap, `design/ecad/band/band-notes.md:71`) and B2 and B7 on FLEX2 (J_BAND_B:2, J_BAND_B:7, the PRT1 tab land P- and disc CP4 are one copper island at 7 of 7 sizes, `design/wiring/review4-work/gnd-islands2.log`); on the board each land goes to the ground plane (`band-interface.md` line 56). This sheet said before that FLEX2 does not join B2 and B7 and that sub-step 10 tests each: that was wrong. One open land of a pair reads as good, so the A6 and A8 beep of sub-step 8, and the cell voltage, the CP4 beep and the USB test of sub-steps 10 and 11, prove each PAIR, not each land. The lead's ruling (`design/wiring/lead-decisions.md:89`): the two are a redundant pair by decision, the electrical test of guide step 14 proves the pair, and no X-ray is asked. The eye, land by land: before the press, sub-step 2 sees each land's own solder dome and that no solder joins two lands; after the press every board land lies wholly under the foot (section 3: lands at |Y| 3.60 to 5.05 and X -3.165 to -1.335, foot at |Y| 3.40 to 5.145 and X -3.50 to -1.00), so sub-step 7 judges the foot as a whole (flat, no lifted corner, not moved, no solder ball beside it). Only the two 0.125 mm ends of a board land could show through the foot, and ribbon copper (tracks on either face, vias) lies over both ends of A4, A5, A7, A8, B4, B5 and B6 at 7 of 7 sizes and over one end only of A1, A2, A3, A6, B1, B2, B3 and B7 (`design/mfg/assembly/guide-fix4-work/logs/foot_cover2.log`, script `design/mfg/assembly/guide-fix4-work/foot_cover.py`). No file says that the coverlay, the 25 um polyimide and the 0.10 mm stiffener let light through (item 8 of section 6): A8 cannot be seen at all after the press, and A6, B2 and B7 only if the stack proves clear enough on the first ribbon.
